identity: A popular general-knowledge trivia miscellany, headed by its column title 'من كل بستان زهرة' (a flower from every garden). Eleven <NL>-delimited blocks: the title line plus ten free-standing 'did you know' factoids on astronomy (the Moon three times, stars, the solar system), geography (Tahiti, Lake Titicaca), history (the first widely circulated coins, Denmark 1224) and botany (lupine in Egypt). Plain modern expository Arabic for a family/school readership. Register is §B/§L encyclopedic-expository, but delivered as short discrete fact-items rather than running argument, so the working sentence target is the corpus base rate of 6-15 tokens, not the 12-20 of continuous expository prose. Blocks run 13-38 content tokens and carry one to four sentences each.
law: Each factoid block is a short stack of complete predications, and each predication is a sentence. (1) Any و / ف / ثم / ولكن that opens a fresh finite clause carrying a NEW argument ends the previous sentence (LAW 1, LAW 2): وتبرز فيها أربع قمم, وهو يبعد, وقد اختفت, ولم يبق, فقد تصل, ثم تنخفض, وأقرب شمس, ويبعد عنا, ويعتبر, وإذا كانت. (2) A fronted possessive-suffixed topic with a nominal predicate starts its own sentence even with no connective at all (LAW C4): مساحتها 1041, أعلاها قمة. (3) THE STANDING EXCEPTION: apodosis-ف after a لو / إذا protasis is grammatical glue, not a resumptive opener (LAW C1) — the whole conditional period protasis+apodosis is ONE sentence, so فإن هذه الرسالة and فإن وصول الرسالة are never boundaries. Likewise result-ف with no new subject welds (§B4). (4) Trailing adjuncts belong to the clause they follow (LAW 4): بسبب تحمله للعطش, باستثناء كوكبي عطارد والزهرة, the locative PP stack after بحيرة تيتيكاكا, and every التي relative. (5) Punctuation removed from inside a token is still reconstructed as a boundary (LAW A1/A2): the decimal point of 4.3 and 8.6, and the dot of the era abbreviation م.
reasoning: CALIBRATION FIRST (LAW 6). Eleven blocks, 252 content tokens. The paragraph structure itself is dense — blocks of 13 to 38 tokens — so the mandatory <NL> boundaries already impose a fast rhythm, and internally the text is a chain of flat fact-statements with almost no subordination. You cannot run الهادي مساحتها together without a pause; a comma here is near-obligatory in printed Arabic and per LAW 0's corollary the comma became a ‖.
